title: Mint House Nashville by Kasa | Accessible 1BD
description:
A unique blend of Nashville's industrial history and modern creativity welcomes guests at Mint House Marathon Village. Choose from a selection of fully furnished apartments with kitchens and in-unit laundry, along with access to a fitness center, outdoor pool, rooftop, and meeting space. Experience this vibrant neighborhood in comfort and style. Our tech-enabled apartments offer self check-in at 4pm, 24/7 guest support by text and Virtual Front Desk accessed via mobile device.

The space
SLEEPING ARRANGEMENT:
- Living area: 1 full-size sofa bed (sleeps 2)
- Bedroom: 1 queen-size bed (sleeps 2)

PARKING:
- Enjoy complimentary parking in the building’s garage, available on a first-come, first-served basis. For your convenience, additional street parking is also available nearby.

LIVING SPACE:
- Full kitchen with microwave, stove, dishwasher, refrigerator, cookware, dishware and silverware 
- Coffee and tea facilities
- Washer and dryer
- Bath products
- Iron and ironing board
- Hairdryer

We offer a selection of room types, each with its own unique features. Decor and layout may vary slightly from what you see in photos.

Guest access
In addition to your private space, you can enjoy the following:

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES
- Fitness center
- Meeting space
- Pool with clubhouse
- Rooftop terrace
- Self-service luggage storage

We manage each aspect of your stay, so you can count on reliable service from booking to checkout, all while enjoying a self-directed experience. Every Kasa offers:

- 24/7 support (text us any time!)
- A desirable locale close to points of interest and attractions
- Professional cleaning
- Thoughtful design for your comfort and convenience 
- Security protocols, including ID verification
- Care-focused technology for detecting noise and smoke

Other things to note
PLEASE NOTE:
- Guests are required to complete a Pre-Arrival Checklist, which includes a virtual ID check, and the option to request early check-in (subject to availability). We operate through a Virtual Front Desk, and self check-in is entirely contactless. We'll send you instructions on accessing our property and your Kasa before you arrive. Questions? Contact us 24/7.
- Enjoy complimentary parking in the building’s garage, available on a first-come, first-served basis. For your convenience, additional street parking is also available nearby.
- One approved dog is allowed per unit at a nightly fee of $8-30/night based on length of stay. 
- Self-service luggage storage is available.
- Housekeeping services are only provided upon request at an additional cost per cleaning.
